standard.confidence_text: 99 % confidence level, k = 2.58, normally distributed (printed p.1-9; the 5790B/AF 50 MHz line is 95 %, k = 2)
standard.reference: Fluke 5790B Operators Manual, Chapter 1 Electrical Specifications, printed pp.1-9 to 1-22 (PDF pp.19-32); "page" fields in this file are PDF page numbers (printed page = PDF page - 10)
standard.author: built from the manual page images by specs/build_5790b_standard_from_manual.py

notes.1: Absolute AC, 70 mV / 220 mV / 700 mV, 10 Hz to 20 Hz (printed p.1-10 marker [1]): for 9.5 to 10 Hz the specification is +/-(1000 ppm of reading + 1.5 uV) (footnote on p.1-11).
notes.2: Absolute AC, 2.2 V / 7 V / 22 V / 70 V, 10 Hz to 20 Hz (markers [2] on pp.1-10, 1-11): for 9.5 to 10 Hz the specification is +/-(1000 ppm of reading) (footnote on p.1-11).
notes.3: Range marked [3] (absolute, p.1-11) / [1] (relative, p.1-13): inputs >100 kHz and with a V*Hz product >2.2E7 are TYPICAL.
notes.4: Marked [4] (absolute, p.1-11) / [2] (relative, p.1-13): typical specification, as determined by sourcing with the Fluke 5205A Precision Power Amplifier.
notes.5: Marked [5] (absolute, p.1-11) / [3] (relative, p.1-13): inputs >30 kHz and >750 V are TYPICAL, as determined by sourcing with the Fluke 5205A.
notes.6: p.1-11 note: the product is to be used in controlled environments; for disturbances on the mains supply of >0.5 Vrms from 10 MHz to 40 MHz, add 5 ppm to the 2.2 V range.
notes.7: Specifications are at a 99 % confidence level, k = 2.58, normally distributed, valid after 30 minutes warm-up or twice the time the product has been off (p.1-9). Temperature: +/-5 degC of calibration temperature (pp.1-10 to 1-13).
notes.8: Non-sine (p.1-14 footnote [1]): specifications apply for non-sinusoidal inputs with crest factor <3.0 and harmonic content band-limited to <1 MHz.
notes.9: Non-sine (p.1-14 footnote [2]): crest factor limited to <2.3 for signals greater than 75 % of full-scale RMS (2.2 V and 22 V ranges).
notes.10: DC (p.1-15 note): specification valid only when the dc input signal is averaged with an equal and opposite dc input signal to eliminate dc offset errors; use of Input 1 for dc is not recommended (thermal EMFs in the N connector).
notes.11: AC/DC Transfer Mode column (pp.1-10 to 1-13): printed as "AC/DC Transfer Mode +/- ppm, 2 Years" with no further definition; stored as ppm of reading, 2 yr only.
notes.12: Wideband (p.1-22 footnote [1]): range limits same as INPUT 1 or INPUT 2.
notes.13: Wideband flatness (p.1-22 footnote [2]): relative to 1 kHz, 1 year, +/-3 degC; for the 2-year specification multiply by 1.5 (not applied here: no 2 yr value is stored).
notes.14: Wideband (p.1-22 footnote [4]): wideband absolute specification is 0 degC to 50 degC at the input connector.
notes.15: Wideband (p.1-22 footnote [5]): 30 MHz - 50 MHz applies to 5790B/5 and 5790B/AF only.
notes.16: Wideband (p.1-22 footnote [6]): on the 7 V range the maximum amplitude is limited to 3.5 V at 30 MHz - 50 MHz.
notes.17: Secondary specification (pp.1-16 to 1-18): 24 hour ac stability, +/-1 degC, slow filter. 2.2 mV / 7 mV / 22 mV ranges are PEAK-TO-PEAK microvolts; 70 mV and above are ppm of reading (p.1-16 row separator "+/- (ppm of Reading)"). Not an accuracy specification.
notes.18: p.1-18 secondary footnote [3]: 70 V / 220 V ranges: inputs with a V*Hz product >2.2E7 are unspecified.
notes.19: p.1-18 secondary footnote [4]/[5]: 700 V and 1000 V rows marked typical, as determined by sourcing with the Fluke 5205A (10 Hz - 20 Hz; 1000 V also >30 kHz and >750 V).
notes.20: 5790B/AF only (p.1-22): absolute specification is +/-0.23 % of voltage reading (1 year, 23 degC +/-3 degC, 95 % confidence, k=2, normally distributed) at 50 MHz, 223.61 mV, referenced to the end of the provided serialized 0.91 m (3 ft) cable; with the cable and 50 MHz Cable Correction the product is only specified within +/-4 % of 50 MHz, 223.61 mV (214.66 mV to 232.55 mV).

problems.what: Direction is "input" (the 5790B measures). specmanager.StandardSpec.lookup() defaults to direction="output": pass direction="input" (or None) to find these rows.
Coverage: 99 % (k = 2.58) per printed p.1-9; specmanager divisor() uses 2.576 for 99 %.
Printed as a bare number under "ppm of Reading + uV" (no uV term, pp.1-10, 1-11, 1-13); stored as ppm of reading with a 0 V fixed term.
Same as above (p.1-13): bare ppm numbers stored with 0 V fixed term.
Same as above (p.1-15): bare ppm numbers stored with 0 V fixed term.

Column header is "AC/DC Transfer Mode +/- ppm 2 Years"; the manual does not say ppm of reading or give a uV term. Stored as ppm of reading, 2 yr only, values printed against the first four frequency rows only (10 Hz - 50 kHz) (printed pp.1-10 to 1-13). Verify before use.
Printed frequency labels are typos: 7 mV first row "10 kHz - 45 Hz", 70 mV second row "45 kHz - 1 kHz" (p.1-14). Read as 10 Hz - 45 Hz and 45 Hz - 1 kHz (same as every other range).
No non-sine specification is printed for 220 V, 700 V, 1000 V (p.1-14); the table ends at 70 V.
Only a 1 year column is printed (tcal +/-5 degC); percent of reading converted to a fraction (0.1 % = 1E-3).

The absolute accuracy columns (90 d / 1 yr / 2 yr) are printed against the first five frequency rows only (10 Hz - 500 kHz); rows 500 kHz - 50 MHz carry flatness only (pp.1-20 to 1-22). Layout read from the image: if the cells were merged across more rows this is wrong. 0 degC to 50 degC.
The flatness column prints a uV term only for 2.2 mV and 7 mV ("+ 0", "+ 1", "+ 2"); 22 mV to 7 V print the percent alone. Stored as printed (bare = 0 V fixed term).

Specification is RELATIVE to 1 kHz, 1 year, +/-3 degC (p.1-22 footnote 2); a "flatness" limit is a difference between two readings, not an absolute accuracy. 2-year values (x 1.5) and flatness temperature coefficient (ppm/degC) are not stored.

problems.what: 5790B/5 and 5790B/AF only (footnote 5); 7 V range limited to 3.5 V amplitude there (footnote 6).
Single point 223.61 mV at 50 MHz, +/-4 % window 214.66 to 232.55 mV; 95 % confidence (k=2) unlike the 99 % of the rest of the file; 23 degC +/-3 degC; includes serialized cable.

problems.where: Voltage, AC [24 hr Stability, Slow Filter]
problems.what: Secondary specification (stability), stored with period "24 hr": peak-to-peak uV (fixed term) for 2.2 mV / 7 mV / 22 mV and ppm of reading for 70 mV and up (p.1-16 row separator). The manual says secondary specs are already included in the uncertainty specifications; do not add them to the accuracy again.
Footnotes: 9.5 - 10 Hz is +/-(1000 ppm + 1.5 uV) on 70 mV - 700 mV and +/-1000 ppm on 2.2 V - 70 V; these are NOT separate rows (see notes 1, 2).

Value bands (amp_lo, amp_hi) are contiguous: each range runs from the previous range top to its own nominal top (first range from 0). The manual's autorange limits (p.1-9, e.g. 220 mV range 60 mV - 220 mV, 1000 V upper limit 1050 V) overlap and are not used for the bands. DC starts at the 220 mV range (no lower DC ranges are specified, p.1-15).

Footnote [3] (p.1-11) is printed on the range label: inputs >100 kHz with V*Hz >2.2E7 are typical. Attached as note 3 to every frequency row of the range; only the stated condition is typical. Likewise 1000 V 20 kHz - 100 kHz (note 5, >750 V) and 700 V / 1000 V 10 Hz - 20 Hz (note 4).

NOT LOADED (no schema field): temperature coefficients and input resistance (pp.1-16 to 1-18), flatness temperature coefficient (pp.1-20 to 1-22), resolution tables (pp.1-9, 1-20 to 1-22), frequency measurement accuracy "100 ppm + 10 digits (10 Hz - 120 Hz), 100 ppm + 2 digits above 120 Hz" (p.1-19: needs the garbled frequency resolution table), A40/A40A shunt AUX input (p.1-20 header), reading rate / settling.
